scripts.build: pnpm --filter @pons-privacy/sdk build && pnpm --filter @pons-privacy/strk20 build && pnpm --filter @pons-privacy/relayer build && pnpm --filter @pons-privacy/web build && pnpm build:evm
scripts.dev:deposit-api: pnpm --filter @pons-privacy/sdk build && pnpm --filter @pons-privacy/relayer build && node --env-file=.env packages/relayer/dist/deposit-main.js
scripts.setup:evm: cd evm && forge soldeer install --config-location foundry
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @pons-privacy/sdk test && pnpm --filter @pons-privacy/strk20 test && pnpm --filter @pons-privacy/relayer test && pnpm --filter @pons-privacy/web test && pnpm test:evm
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @pons-privacy/sdk build && pnpm --filter @pons-privacy/strk20 typecheck && pnpm --filter @pons-privacy/relayer typecheck && pnpm --filter @pons-privacy/web typecheck
